_what: Reviewed threshold for verify-relationships.mjs ISOLATION check.
_rule: The validator fails when the number of people with no resolvable relative EXCEEDS 'isolated'. It also WARNS when it is 3 or more BELOW, so slack cannot silently accumulate again.
_why_not_zero: Many isolated people are genuinely alone in the vault - an immigrant progenitor whose parents were never recorded, or someone whose only relative has no profile. Forcing zero would make the pipeline invent relatives.

_history.note: was a bare constant in the script; reset here for reviewability
measured on HEAD b462f0e across 661 profiles; constant of 25 carried 8 people of unaudited slack, so it is pinned to the measured value

RAISED BY ONE ON PURPOSE, WITH A NAMED PERSON. adam-telfer-1771 (1771-1846) is the target of an explicit parentage hedge: the vault commits parentage_status: unproven and records his two candidate parents in disputed_parent_refs instead of asserting edges. He therefore has zero asserted parents, siblings or spouse BY DESIGN and correctly counts as isolated.
